proof_commitments.replay_standard: same contract + same relevant inputs + same state epoch + same runtime identity -> same decision class
proof_commitments.lineage_standard: each runtime-emitted receipt must verify against the previous authoritative receipt
proof_commitments.tamper_standard: forged outcomes must break receipt integrity or lineage continuity
proof_commitments.commit_attestation_standard: signed commit-time attestation must bind governing basis, authority scope, evidence lineage, and current state at runtime_commit_gate
proof_commitments.boundary_service_standard: all effect-bearing proposals must enter through boundary service envelope and fail closed on missing boundary attestation
